source_description: GitHub issue #105 — Feature: felix-doc-auditor — Documentation Gap Analysis Agent. Builds a specialist OpenClaw agent that processes the audit issues created by doc-audit-trigger.yml and doc-audit-weekly.yml, making high-confidence doc edits directly and creating structured docs-debt issues for gaps requiring judgment. Folds in a small fix to the weekly-audit suppression bug (issue #186 has been blocking new weekly audit issues since 2026-04-19).
